FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

How accurate are the leads?

DataMint pulls live data directly from Google Maps and verifies each phone with a WhatsApp presence check. Email deliverability is validated via Reoon, giving you a 98%+ accuracy rate on exported leads.

Do I need to log in to try it?

No. Scroll up to the Live Playground and simulate a scrape instantly: no account, no email, no credit card. When you're ready for real data, grab a membership.

How fast is the scraping?

Thanks to the dual WAF-bypass engine and cloud acceleration, DataMint can extract thousands of listings in minutes with zero lag, even on Cloudflare-protected sites.

Can I use my own API keys?

Yes. DataMint is fully BYOK: bring your own OpenAI, Serper, and Reoon keys. There's no server-side credit billing or markup, so you control every cent of cost.

What payment methods do you accept?

Membership checkout runs through our secure WooCommerce store at app.datamint.online/get-membership, supporting cards, mobile wallets, and local payment methods.

Can I cancel anytime?

Absolutely. Manage or cancel your membership anytime from your account dashboard. No lock-in, no penalties.
